raw_response:
I will keep my farm simple and manageable because I am 76, my household is small, and I only have 5.5 mu. I will put most of my land into the wheat-maize rotation because that fits my land, my irrigation conditions, and the way people around here farm. I will keep only a smaller piece in cotton because cotton takes more hand work and more watching through the season, and I do not want too much labor pressure. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it matters because I want stable yield more than I want to save a little on seed. I will not push fertilizer too hard, but I will still feed the crops enough to avoid weak growth. Since I have well irrigation, I will irrigate at the key times instead of many times. I will use rotary tillage because it is easier and quicker for me on a small farm. I will spray pesticides only when needed for normal field pressure, not excessively, because I want to control cost and keep the work within my ability.
